title: BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591: three ciphertexts to the Bavarian court, 1531-1537 (DECODE R9403, R9414, R9415; catalogue 162)

steps.what: DECODE images of R9403, R9414, R9415 and neighbours R9404-R9407, R9418-R9422 fetched with the cookie
R9403 read with Łaski's System B key from targets/kaa4591/sysB
R9403: e and r swapped (⋇ = e, X = r), variant sign shapes; DAG word sign = King John
R9403 read line by line, 414/416 words
R9415 transcribed one char per sign; P1 photographed upside down
System A′ key (R9427 gloss) applied to R9415, whose signs look like A′
R9369 (Augurelio's 1531 key) tested on R9415 (L) and R9414 (G)
R9415 P1 l.3 gloss 'incrementum' seeded the key
R9415 annealing with the la model, then beam search (solve.py, beam.py)
R9415 zoom pass: join nulls after clear passages, h ligatures; 386/405 words
R9414 transcribed (v1, then v2 on line-third crops)
R9414 P1 l.6-8 gloss gave the first values of system G
R9414 annealing and de-1500s beam (beam2.py) - about 50% read
R9414 three visual passes over every line (cp12 logs): 77.1% then 91.3%
gapfill.py one-edit lexicon search over unread R9414 words
Web search for Łaski 1531, Zápolya letters to the Bavarian dukes, Augurelio, Acta Tomiciana

Push-to-95% pass: every unread R9414/R9415 word set beside its raw decrypt (decrypt_v2, cp12/dec_*_new) and resolved only where the decrypt itself spells the word: R9414 'Lunden' (P1.34, the Archbishop of Lund, Charles V's negotiator with King John), 'feind' (P3.04), 'befelch' (P2.17), 'handstain' (P4.34, mining term); R9415 're', 'ea'. Remaining gaps not supported by the decrypt left unread.

Full-resolution re-transcription of every non-code R9414 gap (r9414/pass4.txt); accepted 'ist', 'auch er', 'wut', 'sag wan', 'seiner', 'red'; withdrew 'handstain'; found an unkeyed barred-d sign at five gaps and the Psi code at P1.18/P1.25

Joint LM scoring (de-1500s) of the unkeyed barred-d sign over its five R9414 places, all letters and 23 digraphs/short words, plus the large Psi word sign (proposed 'Mt.'); siblings R9403, R9415, System B key and sperantio1534 checked for both signs

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: For R9415 and R9414 (the larger part of the text) the keys of two new homophonic systems were seeded from the contemporary interlinear glosses on each letter ('incrementum' on R9415 P1 l.3; R9414 P1 l.6-8) and completed by annealing and beam search; R9403 was read with the System B key rebuilt from glosses elsewhere in the same volume (kaa4591).
outcome.fraction_read_source: words of the ciphered runs: r9403/decoded.txt 414/416, r9415/count.py reading.txt 388/405, r9414 count_v2.py reading_v5.txt 958/1039 (1760/1860); [..]/? counted unread
outcome.notes: R9403 and R9415 pass the read bar; R9414 is at 92.2%; overall 94.6%. Keys rebuilt for all three (G has ambiguous homophones).

gaps.item: R9414 code signs Ψ, swash X, K (~10 words)
R9414 blotted or struck signs (~15 words)
R9403 P3 l.11-12 two words and P1 l.4 insertion

prior.where: Contemporary interlinear glosses over a few lines of each letter; no edition found (web search 22 Sept 2026).

human: Project-level: DECODE login cookie; the target was assigned by the user. No target-specific intervention.
